newsitem.title: FINLAND: KESKO TO TRANSFER ANTTILA FOOD DEPARTMENTS.
newsitem.headline: KESKO TO TRANSFER ANTTILA FOOD DEPARTMENTS.

text.p: Finnish retail group Kesko Oy said on Friday it would transfer the foodstuffs departments of its Anttila department stores to the merchants who run them.
"There are 25 Ruoka-Anttila departments, and their total sales in 1996 amounted to 1,299 million markka," Kesko said in a statement.
The Ruoka-Anttila departments will continue operating within the premises of Anttila department stores, Kesko said.
The transfer of the food departments to the retailers would be started in the autumn, it said.

"We will sell the Ruoka-Anttila inventories to the shopkeepers who will continue to operate as independent merchants," Matti Kotola, director of Kesko's home and speciality goods division, told Reuters by telephone.
The sale price would be agreed on a case-by-case basis, Kotola said, adding that the sale prices would reflect the value of the underlying inventories.
"There will not be very many of these transfers taking place yet this year," Kotola said.
